notes.title: DurDanto - Early Access is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=BPGtLx5lTUE;full][/previewyoutube]

DurDanto is now available as early access on Steam! The early access includes,

[list]
[*] 6 areas of MadarTek City that are connected as a Metroidvania based world.
[*] 4 Roguelike Dungeons that are separated from MadarTek City. Story progression is connected with these dungeons.
[*] 5 main Boss fights that'll test your wits!
[*] 3 Ability reveals each with their own set of gameplay opportunities!
[*] Minimum story reveal. Spoilers won't impact the current story that much.
[*] Equipable items & Secret/Hidden items to search & collect.
[*] Approximately 10 hours of enjoyable contents that'll keep you excited for the next content releases![/list]

The current state of the game allows us to be in a position to welcome a larger audience and together shape the future of DurDanto. We plan on releasing new contents progressively throughout this year period. We hope that you enjoy the game. If you liked our game please spread the news by sharing it to your freinds & family.

notes.title: DurDanto Demo : Patch Update Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you for trying our demo. We've updated the demo with some changes that are listed below,

[list]
[*] Zubok's Sprites & Animations have been updated for better gaming experience.
[*] Minor UI changes.
[*] Enemies are balanced for better gaming experience.
[*] Minor bugs & glitches are fixed.
[/list]

We hope that you'll enjoy these changes. Thank you for your continuous support.

notes.title: New Demo Available Now!
notes.notes:
Dear Gamers,

We've launched a new demo which features 1 hr content of the original game. The demo is also featured on Steam Next Fest starting from Oct 01, 2021! The demo includes the following,

[olist]
[*] 2 locations with World Map View!
[*] 1 Roguelike Dungeon
[*] 4 equippable items
[*] 2 Skills to unlock
[*] 1 Boss
[/olist]

Please enjoy the demo & leave us feedbacks for improvements if possible. If you liked the demo & want to buy the full version, please wishlist on Steam. Full game will be available on Spring, 2022! Thank you.
